summary: Coherus Oncology filed a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $50 million of common stock under a sales agreement with Leerink Partners dated August 28, 2026. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. Shares trade on Nasdaq under CHRS; last sale was $1.46 on August 27, 2026. Leerink will receive up to 3.0% of gross proceeds as compensation. No escrow arrangement; proceeds for general corporate purposes. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a restructuring or activist event.
